name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 13 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.36 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
